out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The 2024 health department permit was posted, but not the 2026 health department permit.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. Please obtain a copy of the 2026 health permit and post it in place of the 2024 permit.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. There were no paper towels at the main handsink in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. One of the employees refilled the dispenser during the inspection to correct. CDI.

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: Due to improper operation of the hot water, mechanical warewashing machine, the plate-simulating dish thermometer did not reach 160º, indicating that food- contact surfaces of equipment and utensils are not being adequately sanitized.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that a thermolabel will turn black. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces. The PIC contacted the dish machine service company who will check and assess the unit as soon as possible. The PIC will use the 3-compartment sink to sanitize all equipment and utensils. The dish machine may not be used. CDI. The service provided arrived during the inspection and corrected the issue. The machine was not being used and the door was left open. The machine needs a few cycles to get the water hot again after these conditions.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked chicken was 48º, cooked sausage was 64*, raw beef patties were 51º, and raw shrimp was 59º in the 2-door Continental upright refrigerator. This was a repeat violation from the last inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The foods listed were all discarded due to temperature abuse.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed a spray bottle of cleaning solution stored in the speed rail with bitters and other foods at the bar.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. The PIC moved the spray bottle during the inspection to correct. CDI.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Observed 4 packages of vacuum-packed fish thawed improperly. The packages were not cut open to prevent the growth of anaerobic bacteria.
violations.corrective_action: When thawing frozen vacuum-packed fish, ALWAYS cut the packages open when removing them from the freezer to prevent the possible growth of anaerobic bacteria. The EHS educated the chef and the PIC on this requirement. CDI.

violations.title: Food Thermometers Accuracy, Only Degrees F
violations.observation: The food temperature measuring device in the Wittco hot holding cabinet was not accurate. The thermometer read 70º, food in the unit was 140º, and the EHS’s thermometer read an ambient air temperature of 145º.
violations.corrective_action: Food temperature measuring devices that are scaled only in Fahrenheit shall be accurate to +/- 2 degrees F in the intended range of use. Please replace or repair the thermometer on the unit, or install a secondary thermometer in the unit. The PIC ordered another thermometer during the inspection to correct. Please install it when it arrived. CDI. Archer Hotel Falls Church (Inspection Date: 05/12/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Pork belly, raw eggs, and beef patties were stored on the floor in the walk-in refrigerator. Cases of frozen foods were stored on the floor in the walk-in freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. Move all foods off the floor as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months. The PIC corrected this during the inspection. CDI.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: the ice scoop handle was stored in contact with ice in the bar ice bin.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. The EHS moved the ice scoop during the inspection to correct. CDI.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: the 2-door Continental refrigerator was not keeping foods cold enough. The thermometer showed the unit was 37º, but foods in the bottom of the unit were 48º, 51º, and 59º.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Please have the unit serviced as soon as possible and let your EHS know when it has been fixed.

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: The final sanitizing rinse of the mechanical warewashing machine did not reach 160ºF when using an irreversible temperature indicator indicating that food- contact surfaces of equipment and utensils are not being adequately sanitized. The final rinse was 139ºF.
violations.corrective_action: After running the dishwasher through four cycles, the final rinse reached 160ºF. Please have the servicing company check the machine to ensure it is working properly. It should not take multiple cycles to get the unit up to proper temperature. CDI.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: in the Continental 1-door unit near the range, cooked chicken wings were 51º, raw strip steak was 53º, and chili con queso was 53º for over 4 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The CFM discarded all the foods.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: commercial cole slaw in the walk-in was date marked September 15.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. The CFM discarded the product.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: commercial cole slaw in the walk-in was date marked September 15.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. The CFM discarded the product.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: the one continental refrigerator across from the range was not keeping foods cold enough. The thermometer on the unit was reading 39°F, however, foods inside were above 41°F. The EHS put a thermometer in the lower portion of the unit which was registering 49°F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Contact a technician as soon as possible to have the unit serviced. After the unit of serviced contact your EHS so that they follow up can be scheduled.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: observed a milk crate being used to store onions in the dry storage area.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. Discontinue use of the milk crate for food storage. Use a proper container designed for food.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the quaternary ammonia sanitizing solution at the three compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a quaternary ammonia test kit within 10 days. The CFM ordered a test kit online. CDI.

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: Observed heat sanitizing dish machine in main kitchen at 156F. Observed heat sanitizing dish machine in bar area at 133F.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that a thermolabel will turn black. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces. CFM will contact dish machine company for service. Dish machines may be used to wash and rinse dishes and 3 compartment sanitizer basin will be set up with quaternary ammonia for sanitizing dish ware and bar ware. EHS will follow up to verify repair of dish machines.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine. Observed establishment in possession of heat sensitive test strip with minimum temperature of 180F.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. Purchase heat sensitive test strip with minimum temperature of 160F or irreversible temperature thermometer for use in dish machines. EHS will follow up to verify proof of purchase.

out_items.name: Hot and cold water available, adequate pressure

violations.title: Hot Water Capacity to Meet Peak Demands
violations.observation: Observed bar hand sink hot water temperature at 69-70F.
violations.corrective_action: CFM to request service/repair on hand sink so that hot water is able to reach minimum temperature of 100F. EHS will follow up with CFM to verify.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. Observed unapproved splitter installed on mop sink faucet.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS provided approved backflow prevention device product number to CFM. EHS will follow up to verify purchase of approved device.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed food debris on walls behind kitchen dish machine and on walls around cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: precooked chicken at 48F in 2DR Continental Prep Cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Discarded food.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: foil on cart and table by fryer is torn and observed cardboard lining shelves in dry storage.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. Please remove all cardboard from shelves and replace foil every 24 hours or more frequently as needed.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: coolers, stove
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Please clean regularly.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Design Features
violations.observation: The backflow or backsiphonage prevention device installed on the mop sink is not identified as meeting standards set by the American Society of Sanitary Engineering. There are two hoses attached to the diverter putting the system under continuous pressure. Please replace device with one designed for such use.
violations.corrective_action: A backflow or back siphonage prevention device installed on a water supply system shall meet American Society of Sanitary Engineering (A.S.S.E.) standards for construction, installation, maintenance, inspection, and testing for that specific application and type of device. Removed one of the hoses.
